newsitem.title: FRANCE: Suspected Corsican guerrillas bomb two buildings.
newsitem.headline: Suspected Corsican guerrillas bomb two buildings.

text.p: Suspected Corsican separatists launched bomb attacks on a house and a driving school in the Porto-Vecchio area of the French Mediterranean island, police said on Tuesday.
There no reports of injuries in the two attacks late on Monday. No one has claimed responsibility for the bombings.

In the past few weeks Corsican separatists have stepped up their 20-year campaign for greater autonomy from mainland France during which they have planted thousands of bombs, mostly at night to avoid casualties.
Police detained 11 people on Monday in a string of raids on Corsican nationalists. But they found no weapons, bomb-making equipment or illegal documents in the swoops.
Some of the main suspects had slipped away before the police arrived, apparently helped by tip-offs, judicial sources said.
